Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: Test and Release Go CLI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main, master, prod]
    tags: ["*"]

# The list of permissions is explained on the GitHub doc:
# https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-jobs/assigning-permissions-to-jobs
permissions:
  # Write permissions is needed to create a new release
  contents: write
  # allow read access to pull request. Use with `only-new-issues` option.
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  linter:
    name: Linter on a PR
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: Scalingo/actions/go-linter@main

  tests:
    name: Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: Scalingo/actions/go-tests@main

  releases:
    needs: [tests]
    name: GoReleaser Build on All OS but Windows
    if: ${{ github.ref_type == 'tag' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # required by GoReleaser (https://goreleaser.com/ci/actions/#fetch-all-history)
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: "go.mod"
          check-latest: true
      - name: Run GoReleaser
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@a4f02ab5355a589de60d917a659ce617ed19b3de # v7.3.0
        with:
          version: "~> v2"
          args: release --clean
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          CGO_ENABLED: 0

  releases-windows:
    needs: [tests]
    name: GoReleaser Build on Windows
    if: ${{ github.ref_type == 'tag' }}
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # required by GoReleaser (https://goreleaser.com/ci/actions/#fetch-all-history)
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: "go.mod"
          check-latest: true
      - name: Run GoReleaser
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@a4f02ab5355a589de60d917a659ce617ed19b3de # v7.3.0
        with:
          version: "~> v2"
          args: release --config .goreleaser-windows.yaml --clean
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
